mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia), increasing risk of cardiac arrhythmias; amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity which may impair amiodarone clearance.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) closely; correct electrolyte deficiencies; consider alternative antifungal if possible; use lowest effective amiodarone dose.
